builds.title: Spooky Pale Garden Manor
builds.pitch: A spooky pale oak manor where the flowers open at night.
builds.blurb: A gray and white manor where the garden wakes up at night. Grow a tall little house into a manor with three gables and an orange chimney. After dark the windows glow and the eyeblossoms open.
tiers: Starter: a tall pale oak house with two floors, a pointy gable and shutters.
Pro: the full manor, with a balcony, rooms inside and an eyeblossom garden.
Legend: a witch-hat tower with a bell, a hedge maze, a glowing pumpkin and more lights.
teaches: Timber frame walls with dark log beams
Steep roofs that meet in valleys
Small gables that break up a long roof
A tower with a pointy hat
Lighting a build for the night
tips: Eyeblossoms close in the day and open at night. Their orange eyes glow in the dark, but they do not light up the garden.
Smelt a Resin Clump in a furnace to get a Resin Brick. Four of them in a square make a Resin Bricks block.
Use Bone Meal on Pale Hanging Moss to make it one block longer. It never grows on its own.
A Lantern gives light level 15, the brightest there is. A Soul Lantern gives 10, so put soul lanterns closer together.
builds.challenge: Make it yours: Plant an eyeblossom on grass and use Bone Meal on it. More eyeblossoms pop up on the grass around it. Or hang lanterns along the fence.
builds.dad: Dad's Corner: Wait for night in your world and walk the garden together. How many eyeblossoms open? Which window glows the brightest?

builds.title: Happy Ghast Sky Harbor
builds.pitch: A dock up in the clouds where your happy ghast can park.
builds.blurb: Build a harbor in the sky for your happy ghast. Climb the ladder to a deck with copper lanterns and soft wool clouds. Your ghast parks in the empty 4 by 4 by 4 spot between the two piers. Then you step across onto its back.
tiers: Starter: a deck on tall legs, two piers, a flag and a little island.
Pro: a stone tower round the legs. Add a harbor house with a copper roof, shelves and a cloud bank.
Legend: a lookout tower with a crow's nest. Add another flag, a banner, a pier and drifting clouds.
teaches: Soft clouds with a gray wool underside
A deck with a log frame
Leaving the right space for a big mob
tips: Find a Dried Ghast in a Soul Sand Valley. Put it in water. After about 20 minutes, a baby ghast comes out. It grows into a happy ghast.
Craft a Harness from leather, glass and wool. Put it on a grown-up happy ghast so you can ride it.
Use a lead on your happy ghast, then use the lead on a fence post. Now it waits by the dock.
A new block must touch a block that is already there. So build a dirt bridge out to where each cloud goes. Place the cloud against the dirt, then break the dirt away.
When someone stands on top of a happy ghast, it stops moving. Up to four players can ride one.
A happy ghast heals faster in rain or snow, or up high between Y 187 and 196. It must see the sky, so keep its spot open.
builds.challenge: Make it yours: Tint the clouds with Pink Wool Slabs for a sunset. Or paint the flags your colors.
builds.dad: Dad's Corner: Measure the parking spot together. Is it 4 blocks wide, 4 deep and 4 tall? Check that nothing pokes into it, then ride over and park.

builds.title: Cherry Blossom Pagoda
builds.pitch: A pink pagoda with curly roofs, a pond and a bridge.
builds.blurb: Start with a little tea house and a cherry tree. Then stack a pagoda beside it, one roof at a time. Every roof curls up at the corners, and lanterns hang from the tips.
tiers: Starter: a tea house with a curly roof, two stone lanterns and a little cherry tree.
Pro: a pagoda with three roofs, a pond, an arched bridge and a big cherry tree.
Legend: the pagoda grows to five roofs. Add a red gate, a secret ladder to the bell and more lanterns.
teaches: Curly roof corners with stairs and slabs
Roofs that get smaller as they stack
tips: Along each roof edge, the middle blocks are top slabs. Near a corner, step up: a bottom slab, then top slabs one block higher. End each corner with a full block and a stair on top, tall side out. To place a top slab, aim at the top half of a block's side.
A cushion breaks soon after you break the block under it. Lay the floor first, then add cushions.
Aim at the bottom of a block to hang a lantern. It won't hang under a top slab, so use a full block. A lantern gives light level 15.
Up to four pink petals fit on one block. Each time you use Bone Meal on them, you get one more.
The pond takes lots of Water Buckets. Dig a 2 by 2 hole and pour water into two opposite corners. The other two corners fill up by themselves. Now you can fill your bucket there again and again.
builds.challenge: Make it yours: Build a second tea house across the pond. Or try your roofs in a new color.
builds.dad: Dad's Corner: Build the tea house roof together, one corner each. Do all four corners curl up the same way?

builds.title: Autumn Ranger Camp
builds.pitch: A cozy forest camp with a tent, a campfire and a cabin.
builds.blurb: Pitch a wool tent, light the campfire and pull up a cushion. Then build a ranger cabin from the new poplar wood. Finish with a lookout tower and a canoe dock by a tiny pond.
tiers: Starter: an orange wool tent with two straw beds, and a campfire ring with cushions.
Pro: a poplar ranger cabin with a porch, shelves, a chimney and three autumn trees.
Legend: a lookout tower, plus a tiny pond with a dock and a canoe.
teaches: Dark log frames with light log walls
A porch roof that crosses the main roof
Autumn trees in three leaf colors
tips: Straw beds are for one night
A Straw Bed lets you sleep, but it does not move your spawn point. It breaks when you get up, so pack spares. 3 Hay Bales make 4 Straw Beds.
Cushions are made from 3 matching Wool Slabs. Break the block under a cushion and the cushion breaks too.
Put a Hay Bale under your Campfire. The smoke rises 24 blocks instead of about 10. Now your friends can find your camp.
You can put up to 4 Leaf Litter in one spot. Its color changes with the biome.
You do not need a Water Bucket for every block. Pour water in every other block, like a checkerboard. Each gap with water on two sides fills in by itself.
builds.challenge: Make it yours: Add a second tent in a new color for a friend. Then fill the porch shelves with your best finds. Each shelf shows 3 stacks.
builds.dad: Dad's Corner: Plan a pretend camping trip together. What five things would you each pack? Put them in the cabin chest.

builds.title: Copper Workshop
builds.pitch: A clanky copper workshop where a golem sorts your loot.
builds.blurb: Copper changes color as it ages, from shiny orange to sea green. This workshop shows all four colors on purpose: orange at the bottom, green at the top. Put one item in each chest first. Then drop loot in the Copper Chest. A copper golem carries each thing to the chest that already holds it. The frames are labels for you.
tiers: Starter: a little copper shed with a steep roof. Add glowing bulbs, a row of sorting chests and a path.
Pro: a long hall with copper bar windows, roof windows, a workbench, a chimney and flower boxes.
Legend: a clock tower with a lightning rod spire. A low wall with lamp posts goes round the yard.
teaches: Color gradients with the four copper stages
Waxing copper so it keeps its color
A low roof from stairs and slabs
tips: Place a Block of Copper and put a Carved Pumpkin on top. A golem pops out, and the copper turns into a Copper Chest.
The golem takes up to 16 items from a Copper Chest. It puts them in a plain chest that is empty or already holds the same thing.
Two chests side by side join into one big chest. So leave a block between them, like a copper bulb. Then each chest keeps its own things.
Use honeycomb on copper to wax it. Waxed copper never changes color, so your stripes stay put.
A copper golem slowly turns green. Soon after it is all green, it turns into a statue. Use honeycomb on it so it never stops.
A bulb starts dark. Put a button on it and press once. It stays lit.
A lit Copper Bulb gives light level 15. As it turns green, that drops to 12, then 8, then 4.
Put a Clock in the Glow Item Frame. It shows the time of day in your world.
builds.challenge: Make it yours: Add more chests to the sorting row, with a block between each. Put a different item in each chest, and the same item in its frame.
builds.dad: Dad's Corner: Hand your builder a pile of mixed loot. Guess together which chest the golem will pick for each thing, then watch it work.

builds.title: Baby Animal Rescue Barn
builds.pitch: A red barn with cozy stalls for baby animals.
builds.blurb: Build a red and white barn with a curved barn roof and a hay loft. Every stall is ready for a rescued baby animal. Grow golden dandelions by the door. Feed one to a baby animal to keep it small.
tiers: Starter: a small red barn with a curved roof, sliding doors and two stalls.
Pro: a stall wing, a paddock with a water trough, a hay loft and golden dandelion planters.
Legend: a tall silo, a windmill water pump, a cupola and a chicken coop.
teaches: Barn roofs (gambrel shape) from stairs and slabs
White trim on corners and doors
tips: Feed a baby animal a Golden Dandelion and it stops growing up. Feed it another one when you want it to grow.
Put 8 Gold Nuggets around 1 Dandelion. You can plant golden dandelions on grass or dirt, like in the planters here.
Falling onto a Hay Bale takes away most of the fall damage. There is one at the foot of the loft ladder.
An empty Cauldron slowly fills with water when rain falls on it.
builds.challenge: Make it yours: Add a stall for your favorite baby animal. Hang a sign with its name.
builds.dad: Dad's Corner: Pick a name for every baby animal together. Name Tags can now be crafted from 1 Paper and 1 metal nugget.

builds.title: Glass Reef Base
builds.pitch: A glass dome on the sea floor with a coral garden.
builds.blurb: Live under the sea in a glass dome lit by Sea Lanterns. Swim out through the airlock into a coral garden with glowing Sea Pickles. Your nautilus even gets its own parking bay.
tiers: Starter: a glass dome made of stacked circles, with an airlock and a bed.
Pro: a coral garden, a kelp forest, porch lights and a nautilus parking bay.
Legend: a glass tunnel to a garden dome with a glowing Conduit on top.
tips: Coral only stays alive in water. Out of water, coral blocks turn gray in about 2 seconds. Coral fans turn gray at once. Keep your coral garden outside the dome.
Build the glass shell first. Then place Sponges inside to soak up the water. Dry a Wet Sponge in a furnace and use it again.
In Bedrock, a door placed in water stays full of water. Soak up the doorway with a Sponge first. Then place the door.
Feed a nautilus pufferfish. Each one has a 1 in 3 chance to tame it. Put a saddle on it, and your air bar stops going down while you ride.
Put a Conduit in open water. Build a 5 by 5 ring of 16 prismarine blocks around it, at the same height. Sea Lanterns count. Slabs, stairs and walls do not. Then you can breathe underwater near it.
Sea Pickles glow only underwater. Put up to 4 in one spot. Four glow as bright as a Sea Lantern.
builds.challenge: Make it yours: Add a third dome. Or plant a reef with all five kinds of coral. Can you light the whole sea floor with Sea Pickles?
builds.dad: Dad's Corner: Building underwater is a team job. One of you lays the glass. The other follows with Sponges to dry it out.
builds.pack_note: Stand on the sea floor in a deep ocean before you load it. On land, the water spills out.

builds.title: Underground Metro Station
builds.pitch: A subway stop under a park, with a train and ticket booth.
builds.blurb: Go underground! This station is built like a cutaway model, so you can see inside. Walk down the stairs from the park and pass the ticket booth. Then wait on the platform for your train.
tiers: Starter: a platform with benches, lamps, a name sign and a track.
Pro: the whole station under a little park, with stairs, a ticket booth and a tunnel.
Legend: a second platform across the track and a train car made of blocks.
tips: Concrete Stairs and Concrete Slabs came in Wilderness Bound, game version 26.50. They come in all 16 colors. The steps down to this platform are Light Gray Concrete Stairs.
A Powered Rail with no power works like a brake. Your minecart slows down and stops. Power it with a Lever or Redstone Torch next to it, and it speeds carts up.
A Copper Bulb turns on or off each time it gets a redstone pulse. It does not need power to stay lit, so one press of a button is enough.
Copper slowly turns green. Use Honeycomb on it to wax it and keep its color. In Creative, you can pick the Waxed blocks right away.
builds.challenge: Make it yours: Write your station name on the sign. Then dig the tunnel longer and build a second station for your minecart to visit.
builds.dad: Dad's Corner: How many steps go down from the street to the platform? Count them together, then check the layer plan.

builds.title: Pirate Ship with Curved Sails
builds.pitch: A pirate galleon with puffy sails made from wool stairs.
builds.blurb: Set sail on a pirate ship with big white sails that look full of wind. Wool stairs and slabs let you bend each sail into a soft curve. Then fit out the captain's cabin, the treasure hold and a crow's nest.
tiers: Starter: a little sloop with a curved sail, a ship's wheel and a black pirate flag.
Pro: a two-mast ship with a captain's cabin, a treasure hold and a big jib sail.
Legend: three masts, a crow's nest and gold in the hold. Add a palm tree island with a dock and a buried secret.
teaches: Curved sails with wool stairs and slabs
A round hull with upside-down stairs
Trim bands that run around a build
tips: Wool Stairs and Wool Slabs came in Wilderness Bound (26.50). They come in all 16 wool colors.
Start under the yard, the pole the sail hangs from. Move each row one block forward until the middle. Then step back in toward the bottom. Put a wool stair on each step. Put one inside the step too.
Water spreads into any empty space next to it. Fill the whole bottom layer of the hull. If water still gets in, place a dry Sponge in it to soak it up.
A Grindstone looks just like a ship's wheel on a stand. Put it on the deck near the back of the ship. In Bedrock it breaks if nothing holds it up.
You can't plant Short Grass or a Bush on sand. Short Dry Grass and Tall Dry Grass work. Sugar Cane works too, if the sand is next to water.
builds.challenge: Make it yours: Give the sails red stripes with Red Wool Stairs. Or design your own flag on a Loom.
builds.dad: Dad's Corner: Ask your builder which way the wind is blowing. Then walk around the ship together. Do all the sails puff out the same way?

builds.title: Secret Spy Base
builds.pitch: A sweet little cottage with a secret spy base underneath.
builds.blurb: From the garden it looks like a cozy cottage. Flip a lever and a bookcase slides open. Climb down to a hidden base with a computer wall and a quick-swap armory. The chimney is really a periscope.
tiers: Starter: a cozy cottage with a trapdoor in the floor and one hidden room.
Pro: a new wing with a sliding bookcase door, a spy HQ and a periscope chimney.
Legend: an escape tunnel under the garden path to a hollow tree with a lookout deck.
tips: A Sticky Piston pulls its block back when its power turns off. Flip the lever, and four of them pull the bookshelves aside.
Three powered shelves in a row join up. Use one, and all 9 items swap with your hotbar at once.
A Block of Redstone is always on. Hide one behind a lamp or a shelf to keep it powered.
Tinted Glass is see-through, but it blocks light. That makes a dark lookout window for spying.
builds.challenge: Make it yours: Move the lever somewhere sneaky. Then add a second secret exit that only you know about.
builds.dad: Dad's Corner: Redstone is easier with two. One of you reads the steps out loud while the other builds the bookcase door.

builds.title: Camping Tent and Campfire Ring
builds.pitch: A soft wool tent and a cozy ring around the campfire.
builds.blurb: Camp out under the stars! The tent sides are Wool Stairs, so they slope like real cloth. Sleep on Straw Beds, then sit on cushions by the fire.
tips: A Straw Bed lets you sleep through the night. It does not change your spawn point. It breaks after you use it once.
Craft 3 Hay Bales together and you get 4 Straw Beds.
Cushions are made from Wool Slabs. A cushion breaks if the block under it is removed. Put it on a log, a slab or a stair.
A lit Campfire hurts you if you stand on it. Use a shovel on it to put it out.
builds.challenge: Make it yours: Build a second tent in another color. Then hang lanterns on fence posts around the camp.
builds.dad: Dad's Corner: Plan a camp-out night in the game. Who will collect the Hay Bales for the Straw Beds?

builds.title: Dog House with Name Sign
builds.pitch: A cozy home for your dog, with its name over the door.
builds.blurb: Every good dog needs a house. It has a soft wool roof, a red carpet bed and a water bowl by the door. Fill the Cauldron with a Water Bucket. Write your dog's name on the hanging sign.
tips: You can now craft a Name Tag from Paper and a nugget. Rename it on an Anvil, then use it on your dog so it matches the sign.
Use a Glow Ink Sac on the hanging sign. The name will glow, even at night.
Use your tamed wolf to make it sit. It stays in its house and does not follow you until you use it again.
builds.challenge: Make it yours: Change the roof to your dog's favorite color. Or build a bigger house for two dogs.
builds.dad: Dad's Corner: Help choose a name for the sign. What would you call a Minecraft dog?

builds.title: Cushion Sofa and Coffee Table
builds.pitch: Real seats at last: a comfy wool sofa with cushions.
builds.blurb: Wilderness Bound added cushions, so your sofa can have soft seats at last. Build a cozy corner with a wool sofa, a coffee table, a lamp and a rug. Then sit on a cushion and relax.
tips: Put 3 wool slabs of the same color in a row on a crafting table. You get 1 cushion.
Changed your mind? Craft any cushion with a dye to change its color.
A cushion can go on any flat surface. The window seat here is a row of top slabs with cushions on them.
builds.challenge: Make it yours: Pick your favorite sofa color and mix up the cushions. Then add an armchair: one wool block, two wool stairs and a cushion.
builds.dad: Dad's Corner: Which room in your home should be next? Walk it out in steps together, then build it one block per step.

builds.title: Doorbell Cottage
builds.pitch: Press the button and a copper trumpet toots hello.
builds.blurb: This is a real doorbell that works. The button by the door sends power along the redstone dust to a note block. The note block sits on copper, so it plays a trumpet.
tips: A note block on top of copper plays a trumpet. Each copper stage sounds different. Green copper sounds deeper.
Keep the space above the note block empty. A block there stops the trumpet.
Copper slowly turns green, and the trumpet changes with it. Waxed copper stays the same, so this build uses Waxed Block of Copper.
A button powers the block it is on. If that block touches the door, the door opens too. So the button sits two blocks away.
builds.challenge: Make it yours: Tap the note block to change its note. There are 25 notes to try. Can you find the best ding-dong?
builds.dad: Dad's Corner: Ring the bell, then swap the copper for Oxidized Copper. Can your grown-up hear the change with their eyes closed?

builds.title: Mushroom Fairy House
builds.pitch: A spotty toadstool cottage in a glowing firefly garden.
builds.blurb: A tiny cottage hides inside this giant mushroom. White spots dot the red cap, and shelf mushrooms grow on the stem. Switch to Night to see the lanterns glow.
tips: A firefly bush gives off a little light. When it gets dark, glowing fireflies fly around it.
Use bone meal on a firefly bush. It spreads to the blocks around it.
Bone meal turns a small shelf mushroom into a big one. They are a little bit bouncy, too.
Breaking a mushroom block only gives you mushrooms, or nothing. Use a Silk Touch tool to keep the block.
A straw bed is for one night
A straw bed breaks when you wake up. It does not set your spawn point.
builds.challenge: Make it yours: Build a little toadstool next door from Brown Mushroom Blocks. Join them with a path.
builds.dad: Dad's Corner: Switch to Night together and count every light you can find. Which one is the brightest?

builds.title: Mini Hot Air Balloon
builds.pitch: A striped balloon, made round with the new wool stairs.
builds.blurb: Wool stairs and slabs are new in 26.50, and they make this balloon smooth and round. Red and white stripes wrap all the way around. An Iron Chain rope ties the basket to the hill.
tips: Point every stair's tall side toward the middle of the circle. The low step faces out, so the balloon curves.
6 wool blocks make 4 wool stairs. 3 wool blocks make 6 wool slabs.
The hay bale under the burner makes a signal fire. Its smoke rises 24 blocks, right into the balloon.
Grass blocks turn into dirt when you mine them. Build the hill from dirt. Grass spreads onto dirt next to it.
builds.challenge: Make it yours: Pick your own stripe colors. Or make a rainbow, with a new color for each stripe.
builds.dad: Dad's Corner: If your balloon could fly anywhere, where would it go? Plan the trip together on a paper map.
